reason: protocol_v5.json fixes the feature families, splits and reported quantities for Analysis A but does not pin the per-modality scoring procedure. Rule 10 requires the procedure to be frozen BEFORE execution. No Analysis-A detector has been fitted at the time this addendum is written.

detector.name: IsolationForest
detector.rationale: Already the declared external recording-context diagnostic in this project (HAI / Data4Cyber sections), unsupervised, deterministic given a seed, and cheap enough to run at 4 resolutions x 4 modalities x 3 forward steps x 5 seeds. Analysis A measures EVALUATION-DESIGN sensitivity, not detector quality, so the detector is held fixed.
detector.fit_partition: TRAIN-partition benign-reference windows ONLY (never attack recording, never held-out)

session_probe_for_A.name: LogisticRegression
session_probe_for_A.use: strict pre-action separability only (recording membership), time-blocked split

feature_assembly.availability_columns: split out via schema_guard and REPORTED; never a detector input
feature_assembly.missing_modality_policy: report availability; rows with an unavailable view are NOT imputed into the view's own matrix - the view is scored only where present

acceptance_for_A.faithfulness_gate: w=60 multi-resolution records must reproduce the canonical Rev3 60 s extractor exactly (already verified on held-out slices before extraction)
acceptance_for_A.resolution_robust_claim: requires direction of delta_cw AND within-recording ranking at ALL feasible resolutions; infeasible resolutions reported explicitly

prohibited: changing detector or its parameters after observing any Analysis-A result
selecting a resolution or modality subset after seeing delta_cw
